decisions.reason: Turnaround management is a flagship of the firm's data-driven airport operations strategy, with a dedicated web page and close links to its core docking and apron offer.
Apron connectivity enables the integrated platform, though it is only mentioned on the website and may later be folded into broader suite packages.
Equipment monitoring uses the large installed hardware base and supports the growing maintenance and service business.
Apron resource management complements turnaround software and strengthens the integrated suite, even though the firm is consolidating its software portfolio.
